messages.author: fc206658a199d4cf
messages.subject: MCDS output
parts:
Dear List,

I am not getting the output I expected from MCDS engine analysis. I am analyzing
data taken before and after a handcutting treatment. I selected Treatment (Y or
N) and Year (2005 or 2006) as factor covariates. Under the Estimate tab, I
ticked Global and Stratum for Density and Detection Function, and Stratum for
Encounter Rate. What I hoped to end up with was estimates of detection
probability and density for Treated 2005, Treated 2006, Untreated 2005,
Untreated 2006. I could then see if detection probability after treatment
(2006) differed from detection probability before treatment (2005) beyond any
year effect seen in untreated. I used MCDS because I don't have enough
detections in each substratum, so I wanted to use all the observations to
estimate the detection function, then predict seperate probabilities of
detection. However, the output includes Detection Fct/Global/FC1/Plot: Det
Prob for Treatment=N, Year=2006; whereas FC2/Plot: Det Prob is for Treatment=Y,
Year=2005. FC3 is also Treatment=N, Year=2006, and FC4 is also Treatment=Y,
Year=2005. Same with the PDF plots. DISTANCE reports 8 density estimates, 2
for each region (the stratum under which treatment and year are substrata). I
don't know how to interpret what each estimate is for.

Have I set up the analysis incorrectly for the information that I seek? Or am I
just misunderstanding the output?

Thank you,
Claire Crow
